sloka: तत्तृतीयं हनुमतो दृष्ट्वा कर्म सुदुष्करम् ।साधु साध्विति भूतानि प्रश्शंसुस्तदा हरिम् ॥५-१-१७२॥
transliteration: tattṛtīyaṁ hanumato dṛṣṭvā karma suduṣkaram ।sādhu sādhviti bhūtāni praśśaṁsustadā harim ॥5-1-172॥

translations.english: Witnessing Hanuman achieving a very difficult feat for the third time, all the living beings applauded him saying "Well done, welldone".
